summary: Expand source-led YouTube discovery, enumerate admitted channels, and resume audio and transcript collection with explicit coverage and provenance. Publishing this plan does not execute collection.

execution.note: This publication updates the plan; it does not execute new collection. Baseline counts describe the previously published frozen frame.

policy.screening: Preserve existing explicit exclusions; screen art, comedy and mixed content from account and video evidence.
policy.identity: Keep uploader, human medium, publisher, reposter and claimed speaker separate.

query_families.label: Religious and deity labels with channeling context

stages.title: Refresh documentation and access checks
stages.description: Inspect current official tool releases, extractor guidance, relevant Stack Overflow answers and reproducible GitHub issues. Record URLs, dates, access depth and what was actually tested.
stages.acceptance: A fresh permitted connection identifies the failure layer. Runtime, authentication and origin errors are distinct from pre-origin transport failures; no relay or blocked-endpoint evasion.

stages.title: Execute the versioned discovery manifest
stages.description: Run core hashtags, entity/civilization combinations, known aliases and reviewed language variants. Record every query, result page, limitation and evidence trail.
stages.acceptance: Each result has a stable video/account reference and provenance. Search completion never claims a complete global YouTube census.

stages.title: Resolve identities and relevance
stages.description: Confirm canonical channel IDs where possible. Separate medium, uploader, publisher, reposter and claimed speaker. Preserve explicit exclusions and review ambiguous or mixed-content results.
stages.acceptance: Unresolved identities and art/comedy/metaphorical matches remain reviewable; names alone never merge accounts or entities.

stages.title: Enumerate Videos, Shorts and Streams
stages.description: Follow supported continuation pages for all three public channel tabs, deduplicate by video ID and retain per-tab checkpoints and unavailable entries.
stages.acceptance: Every admitted tab has a recorded outcome. Interrupted or backend-limited results remain partial; unknown lifetime totals stay null.

stages.title: Verify one audio-first pilot, then parallelize
stages.description: Use a persistent job ledger, bounded workers, disk reservations, atomic outputs, resumable downloads and rate-aware retries. Apply the Bashar-only duration rule after metadata resolution.
stages.acceptance: One full-duration audio passes media decoding, duration and SHA-256 checks before wider workers run. Failed or resource-held items remain in the queue.

stages.title: Retain captions and run local speech-to-text
stages.description: Keep manual captions, automatic captions, publisher-written editions, translations and ASR outputs distinct. Reuse a pinned local model after resource and integrity checks.
stages.acceptance: Every transcript has source/media identity, language, engine/version or caption origin, timing where available and content hashes. Sample coverage is checked; word accuracy is not invented.

stages.title: Analyze a newly frozen admitted frame
stages.description: Add validated editions without silently overwriting prior ones. Refit topic, TF-IDF, clustering and question-bank analyses only on explicitly admitted source bodies.
stages.acceptance: New results bind the new frame and document deduplication, source-origin/length/context sensitivities and unvalidated Q&A candidates.

stages.title: Publish measured progress and authorized artifacts
stages.description: Update per-channel coverage, storage and failure tables from actual files and receipts. Keep source-specific redistribution terms distinct from the user's public-storage preference.
stages.acceptance: Git and Pages checks pass; remote transfers are verified by bytes. A published plan or object index is never counted as an uploaded recording.

metrics.label: Discovered
metrics.note: Deduplicated observations from recorded queries and publisher links; no download implied.

metrics.label: Enumerated
metrics.unit: video IDs in recorded channel-tab runs
metrics.note: Report tab/run completion separately; union repeated IDs across tabs.

metrics.label: Audio saved
metrics.unit: video/source IDs with verified retained audio
metrics.note: Multiple encodings or aliases do not become independent recordings.

metrics.label: Transcript available
metrics.unit: sources with an admitted text edition
metrics.note: Manual, automatic, written, translated and ASR origins remain explicit.

metrics.label: Analyzed
metrics.unit: selected body units in a frozen analysis run
metrics.note: Metadata and snippets are not counted as transcript analysis.

metrics.label: Failed
metrics.note: A global access hold does not fabricate an individual failed download for every queued video.

metrics.label: Queued / held
metrics.note: Show retry time, access or capacity holds and unresolved metadata; never silently remove pending work.

storage_layout.purpose: Versioned queries and unambiguous planned/executed status.
Canonical account IDs, observed aliases, roles and evidence.
Video IDs, uploader bindings, durations, dates, languages and discovery paths.
Persistent jobs, leases, retry times, checkpoints and completion receipts.
Verified audio and source/output hashes; encoding changes recorded.
Readable text, timed segments and caption/ASR/translation provenance.
Frozen admitted frame, numerical outputs, plots and reproducible code bindings.
Reviewed metadata and permitted derived/source artifacts with an explicit release manifest.

limitations: All query examples are planned seeds, not verified discoveries or identity assertions.
Council of Contract and Council of Contact are separate search terms; spelling similarity is not evidence that they identify the same claimed speaker.
No new YouTube query, download, transcription or analysis is executed by this documentation/UI publication.
The restored checkout and prior public receipts do not independently revalidate every original media file in the restored workspace.
The previous pre-origin YouTube denial and release-upload HTTP401 are historical diagnostics; current access must be tested before collection.
Public storage authorization does not provide a blanket redistribution license for all source media or text.
The existing 8 November corpus and later work must not be summed as independent datasets when sources or editions overlap.
